summary: This 8-K filed by TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund covers routine monthly distribution declarations and an update of net asset value per share for three share classes, plus ongoing continuous offering statistics. No merger, acquisition, buyback, spinoff or other special situation is described. The distributions are ordinary periodic cash payments, and the NAV table is a standard periodic disclosure for a registered closed-end fund. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation or advisor related to a change-of-control event.
